parsed.summary: The PR resolves the issue by renaming the `method` parameter to `dim_method` in the `convert_label_indexer` function. This change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent regressions or compatibility issues.

issues.description: The change introduces a new parameter `dim_method` which might be confusing as it is similar to the existing `method` parameter. It would be better to ensure consistency in naming conventions.
